title: The kb-observer role lists commands its kbask session may not run, and one form that exits 2
goal: each command .claude/agents/kb-observer.md step 4 lets the observer run is admitted by kbask.ALLOWED_TOOLS (or the role names only those), and the coord wait form it gives runs (wait needs --since)

run:
def admits(rule,cmd):
    if not (rule.startswith('Bash(') and rule.endswith(')')): return False
    r=rule[5:-1]
    for suf in (':*',' *','*'):
        if r.endswith(suf): r=r[:-len(suf)];return cmd==r or cmd.startswith(r+' ')
    return cmd==r
import sys,subprocess as s
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbask
C=['python3 _tools/kbmon.py --once','python3 _tools/backlog.py find x','python3 _tools/backlog.py goal','python3 _tools/backlog.py check','python3 _tools/querylog.py where','python3 _tools/rag.py pack x','git diff']
t=open('.claude/agents/kb-observer.md').read()
named=[c for c in C if c.split()[-2 if c.endswith(' x') else -1] in t]
miss=[c for c in named if not any(admits(r,c) for r in kbask.ALLOWED_TOOLS)]
w=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','wait','--timeout','0'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30).returncode if 'wait --timeout 0' in t else 0
print('named, not admitted:',miss,'wait form exit',w);sys.exit(1 if miss or w==2 else 0)

notes: SP-w6amecjt review (and ST-hp5cccy7's worker): under dontAsk the denied commands cost turns of a 30-turn cap; the operator's allow gate on ST-hp5cccy7 holds the list, so the role is the side to narrow unless a gate widens the list.
